summary_1line: Ulupi reveals Arjuna’s death by his son fulfilled a curse for Bhishma’s killing; Arjuna revives, reconciles with Vabhruvahana, and continues the Ashvamedha journey.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vabhruvahana places the radiant celestial gem on Arjuna’s chest as the fallen warrior suddenly opens his red eyes and rises from death.
Celestial flowers rain from the sky while invisible drums thunder as Arjuna awakens and embraces his son on the battlefield.
Ulupi stands calmly beside the grieving Chitrangada and Vabhruvahana while explaining to Arjuna the curse of the Vasus and its expiation.
